title: Goal! Do You Have One for 2024?
topic: Why moving the goal posts can ruin your perfect kick.

source.author: VOA Learning English
source.origin: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories
source.license: Public domain (work of the US federal government)

body: December 31, 2023, means the new year 2024 is nearly here! At this time of the year, many people set New Year’s resolutions. Many people want to make a change in life and others set a goal.
So, today we talk about the word goal. You may know this word because you shout “gooaaal” when your team scores. It is exciting! It is also exciting when we reach our personal goals.

A goal is something we want to reach. It is something we work toward. It is important to have goals in life and a plan to achieve them. A football player’s goal is to score a goal, and a goalie’s goal is to stop a … goal.
Let’s continue talking about sports. Many sports involve not only goals but also a goal line. A goal line gives the space on the field in which you can score or make a goal.

Let’s talk about American football for a minute. That sport involves tall goal posts. To make a point, a kicker can kick a football between the posts and score. Now, imagine if you are kicking that ball. You have the goal posts in your sights. You kick! It looks good! It looks like the ball is going to go between the posts. But then, at the last minute, someone moves the goal posts, and your ball does not go through.

previewWords.gloss: promises people make to change their behaviour
the player whose job is to stop the ball
the player who kicks the ball toward the posts

quiz.q: What is a goal in this passage?
options: something you want to reach and work toward
a penalty for breaking the rules

quiz.q: What happens in American football when a kicker aims for the goal posts?
options: the kicker tries to kick the ball between the posts
the kicker throws the ball to the goalie
the kicker runs the ball across the goal line

quiz.q: What is a goal line used for in sports?
options: it shows how many resolutions a team made
it separates the fans from the players
it marks the space where a goal can be scored
